guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: The Company updated its full year 2026 guidance as reflected in the chart below. The current guidance includes an estimated $16 million adverse impact to Adjusted EBITDA from Hurricane Lowell in Kauai.

(in millions, except per share amounts) | Current2026 Guidance | Previous2026 Guidance
Contract sales | $2,120 | to | $2,140 | $2,080 | to | $2,115
Adjusted EBITDA* | $810 | to | $830 | $805 | to | $830
Adjusted net income attributable to common stockholders* | $315 | to | $335 | $300 | to | $330
Adjusted earnings per share - diluted* | $8.65 | to | $9.15 | $8.25 | to | $9.05
Adjusted free cash flow* | $410 | to | $430 | $410 | to | $460

During the first quarter of 2026, the Company began including interest expense associated with its warehouse credit facility borrowings as a component of consumer financing interest expense. In the third quarter of 2026, interest expense on warehouse credit facility borrowings was $4 million.
The Company’s 2026 guidance is based on the following supplemental estimates:

($ in millions) | Current2026 Guidance | Previous2026 Guidance
Interest expense, net | $176 | to | $174 | $178 | to | $174
Depreciation and amortization | $135 | to | $133 | $140 | to | $138
Tax rate used to calculate adjusted net income attributable to common stockholders | 30% | to | 29% | 31% | to | 29%
